The product README and CHANGELOG do not define NoData; the README states that only land areas are covered. Source: https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/CEMS-EFAS/flood_hazard/README.txt
The v2 method paper models rivers with upstream drainage areas above 500 km²; the current v3 README states no threshold. Source: https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-14-1549-2022

The current directory holds only permanent water bodies and an RP10 spurious-depth flag; the v2 river network map is not present. Source: https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/CEMS-EFAS/flood_hazard/

The local file keeps the name Europe_RP100_filled_depth.tif without a release; the name does not prove a match with a listed version. Source: https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/CEMS-EFAS/flood_hazard/CHANGELOG.txt
The v2 method paper states that the maps do not account for local flood defences. Source: https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-14-1549-2022
